Name: KeepIt
Author: Rogier Dijkman (SecureHats)
Description:
The [KeepIt](https://www.keepit.com) solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to ingest sign-in attempts, item usage, and audit events from your KeepIt Business account using the [KeepIt Events Reporting API](https://developer.1password.com/docs/events-api). This allows you to monitor and investigate events in 1Password in Microsoft Sentinel along with the other applications and services your organization uses.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution depends on the following technologies, and some of which may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or may incur additional ingestion or operational costs:

-  [Azure Functions](https://azure.microsoft.com/services/functions/#overview)
WorkbookBladeDescription: This Microsoft Sentinel Solution installs workbooks. Workbooks provide a flexible canvas for data monitoring, analysis, and creating rich visual reports within the Azure portal. They allow you to combine one or more data sources from Microsoft Sentinel into unified interactive experience.
Analytic Rules: Analytics Rules/KeepIt - Changes to firewall rules.yaml
